description: This file defines the CacheInterface in the Twig templating engine, specifying methods for cache key generation, writing, loading, and timestamp retrieval, but does not include implementations.

classes.name: CacheInterface
classes.description: Interface for cache classes in Twig, outlining methods for cache key generation, template storage, retrieval, and timestamp management.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a specific template class name.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores the compiled template content in the cache under a specified key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a template from the cache using a specified key.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the modification timestamp for a cache key.
